comment: 小院慢生活技能表:采集 6 门(拾柴/采撷/垂钓/捡石/牧养/田作)+ 加工 5 门(灶台/酒瓮/乳酪/缝纫/木作)。xp_to_next 由 round(50 × 等级^1.5) 预生成,索引 0 = 1→2 级。

skills.name: 拾柴
skills.desc: 捡松枝、拾干柴，把山里的柴火归拢成堆。
skills.desc_en: Twigs and logs for the stove.

skills.name: 采撷
skills.desc: 莓子、薄荷、菌子与山参，认得草木就有饭吃。
skills.desc_en: Berries, mint, mushrooms and wild ginseng.

skills.name: 垂钓
skills.desc: 溪鱼、河虾、石斑与鲟鱼，水边的耐心都换成晚饭。
skills.desc_en: Stream fish, shrimp, rock fish and sturgeon.

skills.name: 捡石
skills.desc: 卵石、青石、磨石、砚石到玉矿，河滩与山壁都翻一遍。
skills.desc_en: Pebbles, bluestone, whetstone, inkstone and jade.

skills.name: 牧养
skills.desc: 挤奶、捡蛋、剪毛、打奶油，院里几只牲口养得肥。
skills.desc_en: Milk, eggs, wool and cream from the yard.

skills.name: 田作
skills.desc: 豆子、麦子、亚麻、大麦与桑叶，一亩地轮着种。
skills.desc_en: Beans, wheat, flax, barley and mulberry leaves.

skills.name: 灶台
skills.desc: 柴火饭、溪鱼汤、菌菇煲到百草宴，灶上总有热气。
skills.desc_en: Rice, fish soup, mushroom stew and herbal feasts.

skills.name: 酒瓮
skills.desc: 莓子酿、薄荷露、菌香酱到参茸酒，坛子封得越久越香。
skills.desc_en: Berry wine, mint dew, mushroom sauce and ginseng brew.

skills.name: 乳酪
skills.desc: 鲜酪、黄油、熟成酪与奶糕，奶香从早到晚。
skills.desc_en: Cheese, butter, aged wheels and cream cakes.

skills.name: 缝纫
skills.desc: 亚麻布、羊毛呢、绢帛到云锦，针脚密了才挡风。
skills.desc_en: Linen, wool cloth, silk bolts and brocade.

skills.name: 木作
skills.desc: 木盆、木凳、石磨、木匣到红木柜，榫卯一分不差。
skills.desc_en: Basins, stools, mills, boxes and redwood cabinets.
